baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative around يظن and the passive plural مبعوثون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question lowers the required epistemic threshold: even uncertain supposition should make future rousing behaviorally live. The failure exposed is therefore not merely lack of certainty but failure to admit the possibility at all.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the low epistemic floor that should already alter conduct.
Rousing a still thing into motion makes the passive future a concrete activation rather than a thin doctrinal label.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks whether they believe in resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The ayah asks why even the weakest live possibility of their being forcibly roused has failed to enter their practical reasoning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same يظن that can denote weak supposition can also denote settled knowledge after an indication.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative can accuse the subjects of refusing an inferential transition: an available indication ought to become strong belief, and strong belief ought to register that they are objects of an external dispatch.

activation_trace.role: Certainty reached after an indication supplies an evidence-to-conclusion transition that the question presupposes but the subjects resist.
Dispatch toward a task or destination makes the passive participle a loss of self-directed control.

changed_reading.before: The question contrasts belief with disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The question charges them with interrupting the movement from indication to certainty precisely where certainty would reveal their compelled dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of يظن with the future-oriented state مبعوثون.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of zann names a debt, well, or other matter whose reliability and outcome are not trusted. The question can therefore expose a practical risk model in which the final outcome is discounted as too uncertain to constrain present action.

activation_trace.role: An unreliable matter with an unknown outcome supplies the model of a future liability discounted as doubtful.
Setting out and pressing onward gives the discounted outcome a future trajectory that will proceed despite their calculation.

changed_reading.before: They do not affirm a future event.
changed_reading.after: They price the future event as an unreliable outcome and act as though its probability were behaviorally negligible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deictic group أولئك is made the passive object of بعث while ظن carries an accusation branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots can form a juridical scene without context: a group that should at least suspect its own liability is to be sent for rather than merely restored to biological activity.

activation_trace.role: Suspicion of guilt supplies the defendants' latent awareness that an accusation may attach to them.
Dispatch toward a need or destination supplies the summons that moves suspected subjects into proceedings.

changed_reading.before: They will be brought back to life.
changed_reading.after: They will be sent for as potentially liable subjects, and the question asks why they do not even suspect that summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding actors can measure food, demand completion, invoke a balance, and engineer a deficit. Their failure to infer future dispatch is therefore compartmentalized precision: exact accounting is applied to incoming value and suspended when it would expose outgoing liability.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication turns their own measurable practice into evidence they should be able to carry forward.
Compelled dispatch is the future liability excluded from their otherwise exact calculations.
Measuring food supplies concrete quantitative competence rather than cognitive vagueness.
Completion without deficiency supplies their insistence that value received reach its full amount.
The just balance supplies the norm their selective calculation violates.
Shorting measure names the deliberately produced deficit that makes their epistemic asymmetry visible.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 alternate receiving in full with giving at a loss immediately before the focus question.
The demonstrative in 83:4 points the question back toward those quantitatively skilled actors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact measure, fullness, balance, and shortfall; I add the arrow that competence in accounting should transfer to calculation of future liability. A live alternative is deliberate suppression rather than compartmentalized inference.

changed_reading.before: They fail to entertain resurrection in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: They perform exact calculation whenever it secures an immediate surplus but refuse the same evidential discipline when they themselves become the item due for dispatch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive dispatch in the focus acquires a due point and bodily endpoint: arrival at an appointed severe time culminates in people being made upright for valuation. Resurrection is not diffuse futurity but compelled appearance.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and direction provide the movement toward a fixed proceeding.
Coming to an appointment supplies the due-point structure latent in the future dispatch.
The day's severe occurrence gives the appointment event-weight rather than mere calendar location.
Bodily upright standing supplies the terminal posture of the dispatched subjects.
Valuation and pricing turn standing into an assessive event continuous with the opening transactions.

structural_cues: 83:4-6 run from being dispatched, to a great day, to people standing.
The passive focus form removes the subjects' control over whether they arrive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, severe event, bodily standing, and valuation; I infer that dispatch culminates in compelled assessive appearance. A live alternative is that بعث denotes revival while the following standing independently describes what happens afterward.

changed_reading.before: Being raised means becoming alive again at some future point.
changed_reading.after: Being raised means being delivered, on time and without self-direction, into an upright public valuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material analogy joins the tilted transaction to the standing body: those who make measures unequal are themselves roused into uprightness and equal measure. The body at judgment becomes the corrected scale.

activation_trace.role: Rousing stillness supplies the force that resets the subjects into a new posture.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies the material relation that their transactions distort.
Straightness, balance, and evenness make bodily standing function as rectification.

structural_cues: Active measurers in 83:3 become passive objects in 83:4 and standing bodies in 83:6.
The sequence changes who controls the measuring apparatus and who is positioned by it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alignment, upright balance, and rousing; I add the analogy that the raised body is a corrected scale. A live alternative is strictly legal standing with no material scale metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection transports offenders to judgment.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection materially reverses their distortion: the makers of crooked measure are themselves made upright and commensurable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapping for the governing term carries both sovereignty and a non-dominant image of transactional increase. Against the opening extraction of surplus, being dispatched before the sovereign can also activate an audit of increase taken through asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: Inference from an indication lets the opening surplus function as evidence for the coming audit.
Dispatch carries the extractors toward the authority under whom the surplus is assessed.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authority before whom people stand.
The non-dominant mapped image of increase in a transaction echoes the excess secured by unequal dealing.

structural_cues: Transactional asymmetry opens the sequence, while standing before the governing authority closes it.
The packet explicitly preserves the non-dominant mapped root rather than collapsing the split.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty and a split-root branch of transactional increase; I connect extracted surplus to the authority's audit. A live alternative is that the secondary mapping is only formal resonance and should not color رب in context.

changed_reading.before: They are raised before the Lord in a general scene of judgment.
changed_reading.after: They are dispatched before the owner-sovereign in a scene where the very increase they engineered becomes assessable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of an uncertain debt or outcome is directly pressured by binding books, numbered inscription, accounting, and debt. What the actors price as doubtful liability is represented as already entered, marked, and due; dispatch becomes settlement rather than speculation.

activation_trace.role: The unreliable debt or outcome supplies their practical classification of resurrection as non-collectable liability.
Dispatch supplies the collection event that brings the booked subject to settlement.
A written determination that imposes judgment or decree makes liability binding rather than hypothetical.
Enrollment in a register makes the persons themselves addressable entries.
A numbered written mark supplies exact traceability against their selective accounting.
Accounting and recompense specify the proceeding for which the subjects are dispatched.
Financial debt makes the focus root's doubtful-debt image concrete within the surrounding sequence.

structural_cues: 83:7-9 and 83:18-20 repeat the same book-and-inscription frame for opposed groups.
The opening measure account and the later day of accounting place 83:4 at the hinge between transaction and settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doubtful debt, binding inscription, registration, numbering, accounting, and debt; I infer that the actors have misclassified a booked liability as uncertain. A live alternative is that the debt sense is only analogy while دين denotes recompense without financial texture.

changed_reading.before: They doubt whether resurrection will occur.
changed_reading.after: They treat their future liability like a dubious debt even though the context renders it a registered, numbered account whose subjects will be dispatched for collection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled registry does more than preserve deeds: it routes opposed groups toward confinement or elevation. The dispatch branch of بعث thus acquires differentiated destinations rather than a single undirected awakening.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch toward a destination supplies the routing operation performed on the raised group.
Enrollment in a register supplies classification into an addressable group.
Confinement supplies the downward or closed destination of one registered class.
Elevation supplies the opposed destination of the other registered class.

structural_cues: The two record units repeat كتاب مرقوم while changing the named location and group.
The focus passive plural permits a common dispatch operation with divergent routes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies registration, confinement, elevation, and directed dispatch; I infer a routing mechanism from record to destination. A live alternative is that the locations classify records only and do not specify movement of persons.

changed_reading.before: All subjects are raised into one generic scene.
changed_reading.after: The raised are addressable registered groups dispatched along differentiated trajectories toward confinement or elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context stages an epistemic ladder from supposition to knowledge, visible indication, and the thing's own disclosure, then shows that ladder being turned away and trapped under accretion. The failure to think is dynamically produced blockage, not a neutral shortage of signs.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication defines the inferential transition the later signs should complete.
Uncertain supposition marks the minimal rung they fail to retain even before full knowledge.
Knowledge supplies the higher epistemic state invoked after the focus question.
A visible sign supplies the indication from which strong zann could arise.
A thing's own signification makes the evidence active rather than mute.
An accretion with no exit supplies entrapment that prevents evidence from completing its inferential path.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the cognitive reversal by which an indication is made to point elsewhere.

structural_cues: The focus asks about supposition; later units ask what can make one know and present signs being recited.
The dismissive speech is followed by accumulated acquisition on hearts, making sequence and repetition causally suggestive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies epistemic levels, visible indication, disclosure, entrapment, and turning away; I infer a blockage from repeated acquisition to failed inference. A live alternative is that the coating is consequence rather than cause, leaving the arrow bidirectional.

changed_reading.before: They lack enough evidence to think they will be raised.
changed_reading.after: Available signs could move supposition toward knowledge, but acquired habits turn the signs away and trap cognition before that activation completes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventory places crossing a limit beside a non-dominant return, destination, and ma'ad image. Paired with forward setting-out in the focus, transgression no longer reads as escape past a boundary; its trajectory curves into return.

activation_trace.role: Pressing onward supplies the apparent outward trajectory that the return branch reverses.
Crossing a limit and doing wrong supplies the offender's attempted movement beyond constraint.
The non-dominant return, destination, and ma'ad image folds the outward crossing back toward a terminus.

structural_cues: The transgressor occurs inside the sequence denying the day of accounting.
The packet preserves all mapped targets, including the non-dominant return inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boundary-crossing, forward motion, and a split-root image of return; I add the curved arrow by which overstepping becomes the path back. A live alternative is accidental resonance across mapped roots rather than a contextually active mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The transgressor moves beyond limits and is later raised.
changed_reading.after: The transgressor's apparent escape already contains a return vector, and being raised is the completion of that curved trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch under the recitation root pictures a claim or liability following its owner. This changes dispatch into reunion: what was done is not left behind but follows the addressable person until both arrive together.

activation_trace.role: Doubtful liability supplies the subject's mistaken hope that the claim may not mature or arrive.
Dispatch supplies the movement of the owner toward the point where the attached claim is heard.
A right or liability that follows its owner supplies the persistent attachment between actor and account.

structural_cues: The signs are recited over the addressee after his record has been introduced.
The surrounding sequence repeatedly binds named groups to inscribed accounts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a following liability and directed dispatch; I infer that account and owner travel together into settlement. A live alternative is that the liability branch is too distant from recitation in this occurrence to organize the scene.

changed_reading.before: A person is raised and then separately shown a record.
changed_reading.after: The person is dispatched together with a claim that has followed him, so resurrection reunites owner and liability rather than merely relocating a body.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning links the inward organ that reverses signs, the repeated return home of the mockers, and the later reversal of visible laughter; recompense then returns action to its actor. Being raised is the large-scale turn that changes observer into observed and verdict-giver into assessed subject.

activation_trace.role: A group setting out supplies the transition through which social positions can be reversed.
Turning something from its face supplies the initial inward reversal of evidence.
Return and destination supply the repeated social circuit that later opens into a larger reversal.
The visibly opened face supplies the mockers' original public position.
The same visible expression on the opposite group supplies the observable reversal.
Recompense returning to its actor closes the reversal as a causal return rather than a detached spectacle.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 repeat laughter with the two groups exchanging positions.
83:31 repeats the turning verb, while 83:35 repeats the observers' viewing posture from 83:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward turning, social return, mirrored laughter, and recompense returning to the actor; I infer that resurrection is the mechanism joining these reversals. A live alternative is that the paired scenes show outcome without making reversal part of بعث itself.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection restores the same people in a later setting.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection is a reversal engine: it turns those who controlled measure, gaze, and verdict into measured, seen, and answered subjects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The registered account is attended by those brought near. Dispatch therefore moves the subject from a privately discounted possibility into witnessed presence before an authorized near circle.

activation_trace.role: Private uncertain supposition supplies the epistemic state that public presence will overturn.
Dispatch supplies movement into an attended proceeding.
Presence together with observation makes the record publicly witnessed rather than merely stored.
The privileged near circle supplies authorized attendance around the record.

structural_cues: The witnessing clause follows directly after the second numbered book.
The focus uses a passive plural, compatible with subjects being brought into an already constituted presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, witnessed presence, and privileged proximity; I infer a public proceeding around the account. A live alternative is that the near ones witness the book without witnessing the dispatched subjects.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection changes an unseen possibility into personal experience.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection delivers the subject into an authorized witnessed presence where the formerly discounted account is already attended.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sealed drink supplies a material model of an outcome completed, authenticated, and held intact before access. Paired with rousing from stillness, resurrection can be read as release and manifestation of preserved consequence rather than creation of a new result at the last moment.

activation_trace.role: Rousing latent stillness supplies the transition from held state to manifested activity.
A secured preventing seal supplies intact latency before authorized access.
Completion at the end supplies a terminally finished outcome rather than an unfinished possibility.
Holding and retaining supplies preservation of what the seal contains.

structural_cues: The pleasure sequence moves from a sealed vessel to its terminal disclosure and competitive value.
The focus passive can accommodate release by an external agent rather than self-opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secured sealing, completion, retention, and rousing; I infer a preserved-result-to-manifestation arrow. A live alternative is that sealing only authenticates the drink and contributes no analogy to resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection newly initiates the final outcome.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection opens a completed and preserved latency, manifesting a result already held intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mockers behave as evaluators of others, but the context explicitly denies that they were sent as guardians. The focus supplies their actual passive dispatch: not commissioned overseers, they are the accountable subjects sent into proceedings.

activation_trace.role: Accusation and suspicion of guilt supply the social posture they direct at others and should redirect toward themselves.
Dispatch toward an assigned end supplies their real passive commission.
Sending and setting in motion supply the explicitly negated commission as guardians.
Guarding and watchful custody define the authority they were not given over the believers.

structural_cues: 83:32 records their verdict about the believers; 83:33 immediately denies their authorization to monitor them.
The focus and 83:33 both use passive dispatch language but assign sharply different roles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accusation, dispatch, a negated sending, and guardianship; I infer that the focus names their actual role as respondents rather than overseers. A live alternative is that بعث means revival only and should not be contrasted with رسل as commission.

changed_reading.before: They deny that they will be resurrected after judging others.
changed_reading.after: They mistake themselves for commissioned observers, while the focus asks why they do not suspect their real assignment: being dispatched as the subjects under review.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question makes recompense something that returns to the doer for what was enacted. Being raised is therefore the relay that closes a causal circuit: action leaves the actor, remains traceable, and comes back as its answer.

activation_trace.role: Setting out and proceeding supplies the movement through which the actor reaches the returning result.
Recompense that returns to the worker supplies the circuit's backward leg.
Producing an act supplies the outgoing causal leg whose result returns.

structural_cues: The surah opens with manipulated exchange and closes by asking whether action has been repaid.
The focus question sits near the opening as the missing return leg in the actors' transaction model.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted work, recompense returning to its worker, and forward movement; I make resurrection the relay that reconnects actor and returned result. A live alternative is that resurrection merely precedes recompense without sharing its return structure.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is an event followed by reward or punishment.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection closes the transaction: it carries actors into the point where their own acts return to them as recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a nominal place-or-sign branch under a finite epistemic verb. It remains anchored to the focus root and gains coherence from the paired rousing branch, but downstream prose should present it as a spatial lexical resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of يظن and مبعوثون permits an expected-place image to interact with rousing from stillness.

activation_trace.role: The expected place or sign of a thing supplies the body or conduct as a locus where future activation is already indicated.
Rousing stillness supplies the latent event expected to emerge from that locus.

changed_reading.before: The subjects are asked to hold a proposition about a future event.
changed_reading.after: The subjects are asked why they do not recognize themselves and their conduct as the very site where signs of future activation should be expected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because the uncertain-well image is a remote scope of zann while the later spring is literal context imagery. It remains anchored to the focus's uncertainty and rousing, but should be rendered as a water-based model of mistrusted futurity rather than a lexical gloss of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The uncertain-outcome branch of يظن, including unreliable water, is paired with being roused.

activation_trace.role: An uncertain well or matter whose yield cannot be trusted supplies the subjects' model of the future.
Rousing latent stillness supplies the emergence they treat as unreliable.
A flowing spring supplies the context's assured source in contrast to the focus branch's doubtful well.
Actual drinking turns uncertain yield into realized provision.

changed_reading.before: They assign low credibility to resurrection.
changed_reading.after: They mistrust the future like an unreliable well, while the later spring imagines the raised world as assured, flowing provision rather than uncertain yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because hoped offspring, nearing birth, and childbirth arise from lexical side-images under words used differently in context. The reading remains anchored to zann and rousing as expectation plus emergence; downstream prose should qualify it as a birth analogy for re-emergence, not claim reproductive syntax in 83:4.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A hoped-offspring branch under يظن meets the rousing-from-stillness branch under مبعوثون.

activation_trace.role: Hoped-for offspring supplies expectant possibility oriented toward an emergence not yet visible.
Rousing a still thing supplies the emergence side of the analogy.
Nearing birth supplies a threshold state immediately before emergence.
Childbirth and its issuing life supply the completed transition from latency to appearance.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is restoration after death.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection can be carried, cautiously, as hoped emergence from latency, so the question probes why they exclude even expectant possibility of re-issue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The germination model is surprising because the crop's first watering and raised plant head are non-contextual branch images inside a drink sequence. It remains anchored to the focus image of rousing stillness and is reinforced by actual watering, but prose must label it an ecological analogy rather than an asserted botanical sense of بعث.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive rousing image in مبعوثون can accept a material analogy of externally activated growth.

activation_trace.role: Rousing a still thing into motion supplies the latent-to-active transition.
Giving water supplies the external activation medium.
The crop's first watering supplies initiation of growth from a sealed or finished-looking state.
A raised plant head supplies the visible completion of upward emergence.

changed_reading.before: The dead are awakened as previously complete bodies.
changed_reading.after: The dead are externally activated like latent growth: watered, breaking stillness, and rising into visible form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hostile-person branch of zann rather than its ordinary cognitive senses. It remains anchored to the focus verb and gains contextual support from reputation-directed amusement and asserted verdict, but should be stated as a posture shaping cognition, not as a direct translation of يظن.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The question's epistemic verb carries a branch of hostility while the subjects later issue social verdicts.

activation_trace.role: The adversarial zaneen image supplies hostility as an epistemic posture rather than a mere emotional accompaniment.
Future dispatch supplies the self-implicating conclusion that hostile cognition refuses.
Making sport of people's reputations supplies the social practice through which hostility becomes pleasurable.
A statement functioning as belief or doctrine supplies the hostile verdict they stabilize about others.

changed_reading.before: Their failure to think is an epistemic deficit.
changed_reading.after: Their failure to think is also adversarial cognition: they stabilize suspicious verdicts about others to prevent the same faculty from implicating themselves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it lets a return-to-outcome branch under the word for the former peoples answer the dismissive phrase from within. It remains anchored to the focus's uncertain outcome and forward setting-out, but downstream prose should treat the effect as latent lexical irony, not claim that أولين syntactically means final outcome here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The uncertain-outcome branch of يظن and forward-motion branch of مبعوثون are reactivated by a later return-to-outcome image.

activation_trace.role: The untrusted outcome supplies the future the dismissive speaker tries to make narratively inert.
Pressing onward supplies movement toward the outcome despite dismissal.
Return to a thing's final outcome lets the label for former peoples carry a latent terminus that defeats the dismissal.

changed_reading.before: The speaker dismisses the signs as tales about people of the past.
changed_reading.after: The dismissal ironically names a past whose lexical branch still moves toward outcome and return, reactivating the future the speaker discounts.

strongest_changes: The opening measurers are not cognitively imprecise; they compartmentalize precision so future liability never enters the account.
The uncertain-debt branch of zann is overturned by binding, numbered registers and din as both debt and recompense.
Ba'th expands from revival into compelled dispatch, upright valuation, witnessed presence, and differentiated routing.
The denial of a guardian commission reverses the mockers' self-appointed role: they are not sent to inspect others but will themselves be dispatched for review.
The closing return of recompense makes resurrection the relay that brings enacted value back to its actor.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained coexisting epistemic, commercial, juridical, spatial, social, and material readings without merging them. Especially productive were the focus branch for an unreliable debt or well, the dispatch sense of ba'th, and preserved non-dominant mappings that folded transactional increase and return into the surrounding account.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain how strongly dispatch should color the contextual sense of resurrection rather than remain a functional branch resonance.
The split-root surplus and return models are packet-licensed but form-distant, so their explanatory force may exceed their contextual force.
The sealed vessel, spring, birth, and germination models are live analogies anchored to the focus, but they should not be promoted into direct lexical substitutions.
